title: 2020 AMC 8 Problem 11
statement: After school, Maya and Naomi headed to the beach, \(6\) miles away. Maya decided to bike while Naomi took a bus. The graph below shows their journeys, indicating the time and distance traveled. What was the difference, in miles per hour, between Naomi’s and Maya’s average speeds?

solutions.text:
Naomi traveled \(6\) miles in \(10\) minutes, so her average speed was \[\dfrac{6}{\frac{10}{60}}=36\] miles per hour.

Maya traveled \(6\) miles in \(30\) minutes, so her average speed was \[\dfrac{6}{\frac{30}{60}}=12\] miles per hour.

This difference is \(36-12=24.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Read each person’s time to travel \(6\) miles
Convert \(10\) minutes and \(30\) minutes to hours
